items.title: Scott Yanow interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021
items.q: Scott was interviewed via Zoom on October 22, 2021 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Scott was interviewed via Zoom on October 22, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Scott Yanow with me today, who is an author, a jazz journalist, and quite a resource for jazz knowledge. That’s the way I’m going to introduce you, I hope that works.
